entries.message: Fix - Keep alternate-order episode watches from being unwatched again, and catch Plex watch changes made in bursts
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: A watch of an episode in an alternate order (such as a DVD-order show) is no longer marked unwatched again a few minutes later by the Plex, Emby and Jellyfin background checks, which looked the episode up by its aired numbers and read a different, unplayed episode.
Watched or unwatched changes made in Plex Web are now picked up through Plex's notification socket, and a burst of manual Mark as watched clicks in Plex no longer skips the oldest episodes.
